\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \frac{1}{n - 2t} \sum_{k = t + 1}^{n - t} W_{(k)},
\qquad
n = 3^2,\quad t = 2
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(W_{(k)}\): The k-th smallest value of the window
- \(n\): Number of values in the window
- \(t\): Values dropped at each end

W with index (k) is the k-th smallest value of the window. The t smallest and the t largest values are dropped, and the n - 2t values in the middle are averaged. Gonzalez and Woods write d = 2t for the number of dropped values.
